challenges.statement: The SDUI payload contains 7 distinct high-priority components (POINTS_BALANCE, INSTANT_REWARD_POPUP, FLASH_REWARD_BANNER, QUICK_REDEEM_CARD, TANGIBLE_VALUE_CARD, QUICK_WIN_CARD, PERSONALIZED_OFFER_CARD). This results in extreme cognitive load, violating design best practices for mobile interfaces and risking component overload.

The combination of an instant reward popup with a 2-hour expiration timer, a live countdown timer on the flash banner ('01:45:20'), and multiple single-tap claim triggers creates an aggressive pressure environment inconsistent with calm customer experiences.

releaseReasons: Payload violates component count thresholds by cramming 7 interactive promotional and transactional widgets into a single view.
Component overload risks severe cognitive fatigue and choice paralysis for the customer.

agentMessages.summary: HOLD recommended due to Component Overload. 7 active components create excessive cognitive load and decision fatigue.
